csv_project_name: As Needed Reading & South Ward Senior Center CDBG Project
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Trenton, Department of Health and Human Services is requesting sealed Request for Proposals for Architectural and Engineering Services to assist in the implementation and completion of various CDBG projects. A contract or contracts regarding the above services will be awarded on an as needed basis through a fair and open process in accordance with N.J.S.A. 19:44A-20.5 et seq. to provide the City of Trenton with Architectural and Engineering Services for city owned and/or nonprofit buildings.
